title: Designing and checking a composite wing box
waiting: The wing's chat is not built yet: the wing page and its check are in draft PR #244, and a chat that edits a wing is a later step. These are the questions it must answer when it lands.

questions.ask: Add 2 0° plies to the spar caps from the root to 40% span

live.judge: Proposes two 0° plies on both spar caps from 0 to 40% span for the engineer to tick; names the ply drop at 40% span and its ramp ratio; says whether the caps still meet the 10% rule and the limit on consecutive plies of one angle; writes no number that is not the wing's or the rule's

questions.ask: what allowables are you using for the spar caps?

live.judge: Names the material, the dataset and whether the strengths are mean or B-basis values, with the source

questions.ask: which ASTM test gives the compression allowable?

live.judge: Names the ASTM compression method the dataset's strength comes from, without inventing one

questions.ask: what ply drop ratio should I use?

live.judge: Gives the ramp ratio from our design rules and where it is checked

questions.ask: how many 0° plies can I stack together?

live.judge: Gives the limit on consecutive plies of one angle from our design rules

questions.ask: does my skin meet the 10% rule?

live.judge: Opens with Yes or No, then each direction's share of the skin's plies

questions.ask: is the spar cap laminate balanced and symmetric?

live.judge: Opens with Yes or No for each, from the wing's own layup
Names the part (skin, spar cap, web) and the margin, from the wing's check

questions.ask: what is the margin of safety of the web?

live.judge: The web's margin from the wing's check, with what it is against (buckling or strength)

questions.ask: why does the web buckle first?

live.judge: From the wing's facts and the theory pages; no number not in them
The tip deflection from the wing's check, with its load case

questions.ask: make the spar caps thicker near the root

live.judge: Asks how much, or proposes plies for the engineer to tick; never changes the wing on its own
Proposes a rib at 60% span for the engineer to tick

questions.ask: whats the weight of the wing box

live.judge: The wing box's mass from the wing's own numbers, or says it is not computed yet
